"""Exercise the nullable relationship used by Django's own query tests."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path[:0] = [str(Path.cwd()), str(Path.cwd() / "tests"), "/deps/lib"]
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(INSTALLED_APPS=["queries"], DATABASES={
    "default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}})
import django
django.setup()
from django.db import connection
from django.db.models import Q
from queries.models import BaseA, FK1, FK2, FK3

with connection.schema_editor() as schema:
    for model in (FK1, FK2, FK3, BaseA):
        schema.create_model(model)
row = BaseA.objects.create()
query = BaseA.objects.filter(~(Q(a__f1__isnull=True) ^ Q(a__f2__isnull=True)))
print(json.dumps({"inserted": row.pk, "returned": list(query.values_list("pk", flat=True)),
                  "expected": [row.pk], "sql": str(query.query)}))
